headers.//: Baseline security headers — applied to every response. Conservative set that does not risk breaking the app (no enforcing CSP yet; that needs Report-Only first). Each header maps to a Mozilla Observatory / Lighthouse a11y/security check.

headers.value: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(self "https://js.stripe.com"), usb=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), accelerometer=()

headers.//: Hashed Vite assets are content-addressed — safe to cache for a year.
Brand assets and static images get a long cache too. Names are stable.
llms.txt and robots.txt: daily cache so updates propagate fast.
